description: Source code implementing a server-side component of the TinySRP (Secure Remote Password) protocol, including functions for initializing server state, generating ephemeral keys, computing session keys, verifying responses, and cleanup.

methods.name: t_serveropenraw
methods.description: Initializes server state with user credentials and cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: t_servergenexp
methods.description: Generates ephemeral server public value B based on private b.

methods.name: t_servergetkey
methods.description: Computes session key based on client public value and server state.

methods.name: t_serververify
methods.description: Verifies server response against expected hash for authentication.

methods.name: t_serverresponse
methods.description: Returns the server's session response hash.

methods.name: t_serverclose
methods.description: Cleans up server state and frees memory.
